name: Two Figures Soar and Bounce Over Rooftops
description: Two figures glide above the houses, moving smoothly through the air. They land briefly on rooftops, springing off with force, and continue their path in a series of floating leaps.
related_events: Two individuals fly over houses and bounce off rooftops using floating skills

name: Tsai and May Enter the House
description: Tsai and May arrive at a house and go inside. They stand together in the interior, the door closing behind them.
related_events: Tsai and May enter the house

name: Jen Returns to Her Bed
description: Jen sighs, then turns back toward her bed.
related_events: Jen turns back toward her bed

name: Raising the Lanterns
description: Two lanterns, lit and glowing, were lifted into the air. They cast light upward, breaking the darkness around them.
related_events: Lanterns are raised up

name: Yu Fights the Black Figure for the Sword
description: Yu clashes with the Black Figure in a fierce struggle. Amid the fight, Yu shouts, demanding the Black Figure return the stolen sword.
related_events: Yu and the Black Figure engage in combat
Yu demands the return of the sword

name: Aunt Wu Summons Shu Lien
description: Aunt Wu rushes through the halls, calling out for Shu Lien.
related_events: Aunt Wu hurries through the halls calling out to Shu Lien

name: De Lu Escorts Yu to Sir Te
description: De Lu leads Yu into Te's establishment. Once inside, De Lu says, "Sir Te awaits you."
related_events: De Lu escorts Yu into Te's establishment
De Lu announces that Sir Te awaits Yu

name: Yu Enters to Find Li Mu Bai
description: Yu is ushered into the room and sees Sir Te speaking with a man whose back is to her. The man turns around, revealing himself to be Li Mu Bai.
related_events: Yu is ushered into the room and discovers Sir Te with another man
Li Mu Bai reveals himself after turning around

name: Tsai and May Leave the Tree and Walk Away
description: Tsai and May, having been hidden in the branches of a tree while watching Jen, drop down silently and walk away. From a rooftop nearby, Lo watches them without making a sound.
related_events: Tsai and May drop from tree branches and walk away silently
Lo observes Tsai and May from another rooftop

name: Yu Packs for the Convoy as Aunt Wu Arrives Unexpectedly
description: Yu was wrapping a few small items in a linen cloth, finishing her preparations for the convoy journey, when Aunt Wu suddenly burst into the room.
related_events: Yu prepares belongings for the convoy
Aunt Wu enters abruptly while Yu is packing

name: Bo Searches for the Tsais on a Crowded Bridge
description: Bo walks across a bridge filled with jugglers performing tricks, their movements drawing attention from everyone around. He scans the crowd, looking from side to side, but the Tsais are not there. Despite his efforts, he cannot find them among the shifting patterns of the performers and onlookers.
related_events: Bo searches for the Tsais on the bridge
Jugglers perform on the bridge

name: Master Bo's Security Patrol at the Compound
description: A wide shot shows the quiet compound under the night sky. Master Bo arrives and is greeted by a patrol man, who acknowledges him with a nod. 'Chilly, eh?' Master Bo says. 'Yes, Master Bo,' the patrol man replies. As Master Bo continues walking along the path, a faint rustling stirs in the treetop behind him, the shadows shifting briefly before stillness returns.
related_events: Patrol man greets Master Bo at the compound
Shadows rustle in treetop as Master Bo walks on

name: Yu Leads Sun Security Caravan into Peking
description: Customs officials stepped back from the line of carriages bearing the Sun Security insignia, their inspection complete. The caravan, drawn up in a neat row, began to move forward slowly, wheels creaking as they crossed the checkpoint boundary into Peking. Yu, mounted on a tall, dark horse at the front, gave a slight nod. 'Thanks. Let's go into the city,' she said. The carriages rolled forward, following her lead, and the group made their way into the city beyond.
related_events: Customs officials complete inspection of Sun Security carriages
Sun Security caravan passes through checkpoint into Peking
Yu leads crew into the city after inspection

name: Bo Hears Clashing Weapons and Changes Direction
description: Bo runs through the streets in pursuit of the thief. The thief is nowhere in sight. Suddenly, the sound of clashing weapons echoes nearby. Bo stops, turns, and hurries toward the source of the noise.
related_events: Bo runs through the streets in pursuit
Weapons clash heard nearby
Bo hurries toward the sound of clashing weapons

name: May Enters the House and Oils Her Weapon with Tsai
description: May steps through the broken bamboo fence and enters a dilapidated house. Bo moves closer, approaching carefully. Inside, May and Tsai are crouched, rubbing oil onto their weapons.
related_events: May enters dilapidated house through broken bamboo fence
Bo cautiously approaches May and Tsai
May and Tsai apply oil to their weapons

name: Bo Questions a Homeless Man and Follows May into an Alley
description: Bo asks a homeless man about the location of certain individuals, but the man says he doesn't know and hasn't seen them in two days. Bo starts to walk away, then notices May hurrying into an alley. He turns and follows her.
related_events: Bo questions a homeless man about someone's whereabouts
Bo spots May entering an alley and decides to follow her

name: Jen and Madam Yu in the Desert Caravan
description: Jen sits in a carriage moving across a vast desert, her eyes fixed on the rugged mountainside as the dry wind blows through her hair. Around her, the caravan advances slowly under the open sky, guarded by riders on horseback. Across from her, Madam Yu mutters in irritation about the barren landscape, calling it a godforsaken place, and questions why her husband could not have been assigned somewhere closer to civilization. Jen does not respond, still gazing out at the passing terrain.
related_events: Madam Yu complains about the remote desert location
Jen observes the desert landscape from a moving carriage

name: Yu is escorted out and sees the Governess watching
description: The maid led Yu out of the room. As they moved down the hall, Yu paused and looked around. From the corner of her eye, she saw the Governess peering at her from around a distant corner, half-hidden in shadow.
related_events: Maid escorts Yu out of the room
Yu pauses and looks around
Yu sees the Governess peering from around a corner

name: Confrontation with the Hooded Figure
description: Tsai and May fought against the hooded figure in a fierce clash. As the battle unfolded, the figure suddenly leapt into the air, executing a gravity-defying flip over the wall and disappearing from sight. Bo arrived moments later, seeing only the figure's escape, and shouted, 'Do something! He's getting away!'
related_events: Hooded figure battles Tsai and May
Hooded figure performs gravity defying flip and escapes over wall
Bo arrives at battle scene and urges action

name: Jen Leaves the Study and Bids Yu Farewell
description: Jen exits the study with her maid by her side. As she departs, she turns to Yu and offers a final good-bye. Yu watches her, his expression shifting with quiet intrigue.
related_events: Jen leaves the study escorted by her maid
Jen turns to Yu for a final good-bye
Yu shows intrigue after encountering Jen

name: May invites Bo inside to escape the cold and stand together
description: May opens her door and sees Bo standing outside, keeping watch. She asks him to come in. Bo stays in place, saying he is standing guard. May turns back inside, then pauses. She faces him again and invites him to come in once more, telling him it is cold. She adds that they do not have to fear Jade Fox if they are together.
related_events: May opens her door and finds Bo standing guard
Bo refuses initial invitation to enter
May invites Bo to come inside multiple times
May hesitates before re-engaging Bo
May asserts safety through unity against Jade Fox

name: Yu Overpowers Thief but Loses Him to an Arrow Distraction
description: Yu pressed forward in the fight, forcing the thief back with precise movements. As she gained the upper hand, a small arrow cut through the night air toward her. She caught it mid-flight, fingers closing around the shaft in an instant. In that moment, the thief turned and fled, vanishing into the shadows. Yu stood alone in the courtyard, the arrow in her hand, its feathers brushing her palm as she turned it slowly under the dim light.
related_events: Yu gains upper hand in fight with thief
Arrow shoots toward Yu during confrontation
Yu catches incoming arrow mid-flight
Thief escapes during distraction
Yu examines arrow after thief's escape

name: Yu Proposes a Trap Using Fox's Daughter
description: Te, Li, and Yu sit together, discussing how to deal with Fox. Te insists the matter must be resolved quickly. Li offers to enter the Yu household, find Madam Yu and her daughter, and capture Fox and her gang. Yu cautions that Governor Yu holds a high position and oversees security, so any disturbance could bring suspicion upon him and endanger Te. Te acknowledges the situation is delicate. Yu then suggests a way forward: Te should find a reason to invite Madam Yu and her daughter to his residence. Te asks what Yu has in mind. Yu replies that the best way to trap a fox is through her cubs. Te and Li remain silent, considering his words.
related_events: Sir Te emphasizes urgency in resolving the matter
Li volunteers to infiltrate Yu household and capture Fox
Yu warns of risks involving Governor Yu's position
Yu proposes luring Fox by inviting her daughter
related_occasions: Strategy Discussion Among Te, Li, And Yu

name: Bo Accuses the Yu Household, Sir Te Suspects a Setup
description: Men stand at attention as Bo declares that the thief must be in the Yu household. Sir Te cuts him off, refusing to hear more, and orders the men to leave. Bo exits, visibly frustrated. Once he is gone, Yu asks if Governor Yu has ever seen the sword. Sir Te replies that he has, though he doubts the governor's involvement. Yu suggests the sword might be hidden within the governor's compound. Sir Te warns that someone may be trying to frame him and decides to send word to Li Mu Bai.
related_events: Bo accuses the Yu household of harboring the thief
Sir Te interrupts Bo and ends the confrontation
Yu questions whether Governor Yu has seen the sword
Sir Te suspects a setup against Governor Yu
Sir Te decides to inform Li Mu Bai

name: Yu Observes the Street from Horseback
description: Yu sits atop her horse on the crowded boulevard, watching as people, horses, and carriages jostle for space along the dusty, congested street. A group of jugglers performs at a nearby corner, drawing glances from passersby. She remains still, taking in the movement and noise of the city around her.
related_events: Yu surveys the busy street from horseback

name: Yu Watches Jugglers on the Boulevard
description: At a corner of the busy boulevard, a group of jugglers toss flaming torches into the air, drawing a small crowd. Passersby slow their steps, some stopping to watch as the performers spin and catch the fire in quick, practiced motions. Horses and carriages weave around the gathering, adding to the noise and movement of the street. From atop her horse, Yu looks over toward the performers, her gaze settling on the spinning flames amid the dust and motion.
related_events: Jugglers perform at a street corner

name: Yu Confronts the Thief on the Rooftop
description: Yu intercepts the hooded thief on a rooftop and demands the return of the sword. The thief stands silent, shifting slightly in stance. Yu attacks, but the thief repels her strike. Recognizing the opponent's skill, Yu asks if they were trained at Wudan. Without answering, the thief leaps to a nearby rooftop. Yu follows, closing the distance, and launches a relentless series of rapid strikes.
related_events: Yu confronts the hooded thief on the rooftop

name: Yu Pursues the Hooded Figure Across Rooftops
description: After the hooded figure repelled Yu's attack, they leapt to another rooftop and fled. Yu gave chase, caught up to them, and resumed her assault with a rapid series of blows.
related_events: Hooded figure repels Yu's attack
Hooded figure leaps to another rooftop to evade capture
Yu catches up to the fleeing figure and resumes attack

name: Unloading and Verifying the Medicinal Herb Shipment
description: Workers unloaded the medicinal herbs from the carriages. Boss Giao inspected the cargo and confirmed that all items had arrived safely. She thanked Yu for ensuring the delivery reached its destination without incident.
related_events: Workers unload medicinal herbs from carriages
Boss Giao verifies the delivery of medicinal herbs
Boss Giao expresses gratitude to Yu for safe delivery

name: Giao Thanks Yu for His Service
description: Boss Giao inspects the unloaded cargo and confirms that all the medicinal herbs arrived safely. He thanks Yu for the delivery. Yu responds that he is just doing his job. Giao remarks that Sun Security has been the best since Yu's father founded it and says that Yu honors his father's memory. Yu thanks him in return.
related_events: Boss Giao praises Yu for upholding his father's legacy
Yu acknowledges Boss Giao's compliment with thanks

name: Tsai Confronts the Hooded Intruder and Reveals Bo
description: Inside the tiny house, a hooded figure rummages through their belongings. Tsai reacts instantly, throwing a knife that tears off the figure's mask, revealing Bo beneath. Without hesitation, Tsai draws a second knife and presses it to Bo's throat, demanding to know who he is. Bo raises his hands, shouting that he's a friend.
related_events: Tsai throws knife to unmask hooded intruder
Bo is revealed as the hooded intruder
Tsai holds second knife to Bo's throat

name: Bo Claims to Be a Friend Under Threat
description: Inside the tiny house, a hooded figure rummages through their belongings. Tsai reacts instantly, throwing a knife that tears off the figure's mask, revealing Bo beneath. Tsai draws a second knife and presses it to Bo's throat. Bo freezes, hands up, and shouts that he's a friend. Tsai hesitates, the blade still against Bo's skin.
related_events: Bo claims to be a friend under threat

name: Loading the Convoy and Li Mu Bai's Arrival
description: Security men and porters move steadily, loading supplies onto wagons preparing for departure. Across the lake, a lone horseman rides into the village. One of the workers spots him and calls out, "Master Li is here!" The man on horseback is Li Mu Bai, a strong and striking figure in his thirties. In the background, old Aunt Wu sees him, drops her parcels, and hurries excitedly into a nearby building.
related_events: Workers load wagons for a convoy
Horseman enters village across the lake

name: Worker Announces Li Mu Bai's Arrival
description: As security men and porters loaded wagons for a convoy, a lone horseman appeared across the lake, riding into the village. One of the workers spotted him and called out, "Master Li is here!" Li Mu Bai, a man in his thirties with a strong and striking presence, rode closer. In the background, old Aunt Wu saw him, dropped her parcels, and hurried excitedly into a nearby building.
related_events: Worker identifies Master Li
Li Mu Bai is revealed approaching the village

name: Aunt Wu Reacts to Li Mu Bai's Arrival
description: As Li Mu Bai rides into the village, old Aunt Wu sees him from across the lake. She drops her parcels and runs excitedly into the building.
related_events: Aunt Wu drops parcels and runs upon seeing Li Mu Bai

name: Confrontation at the Monastery
description: The figure bursts into the old monastery, where Li is already waiting. Li asks if she's had enough flying, telling her she has potential but doesn't understand the Wudan Manual without a real master. The figure remains silent, her eyes betraying a quiet pride. She challenges Li, demanding to know if he considers himself a true master. Li responds that like all things, he is nothing, and that even the sword is merely a state of mind. The figure snaps at him to stop speaking like a monk and calls for a fight. Li remains calm, asking her to reveal Jade Fox's location. Ignoring the question, she issues a final challenge: 'On guard!' Li replies that true sharpness comes without effort.
related_events: Figure enters old monastery and confronts Li
Figure challenges Li to fight

name: Li Demands the Figure Reveal Jade Fox's Location
description: Li stands facing the figure in the old monastery. The figure bounces in, breathing heavily, as if she has been flying. Li asks if she has had enough flying and tells her she has potential but does not understand the Wudan Manual without a real master. The figure remains silent, her eyes showing pride. She challenges Li, demanding he stop speaking like a monk and fight. Li does not move to attack. Instead, he asks her where Jade Fox is. The figure ignores the question and raises her weapon, calling for Li to take a fighting stance. Li remains still, speaking of sharpness without effort as the figure prepares to strike.
related_events: Li questions figure about Jade Fox

name: Li Teaches the Nature of True Sharpness
description: The figure bursts into an old monastery where Li is waiting. Li asks if she has had enough flying, acknowledging her potential but noting she has studied the Wudan Manual without understanding it. He tells her she needs a real master. The figure remains silent, her eyes betraying pride. She challenges Li, demanding he stop speaking like a monk and fight. Li refuses unless she reveals Jade Fox’s location. Insisting, she calls out, 'On guard!' Calmly, Li responds that real sharpness comes without effort.
related_events: Li explains nature of true sharpness

name: Bo Confronts Tsai and May After Their Hasty Departure
description: Bo follows Tsai and May, who are quickly walking away. He calls out, questioning what they are doing. Tsai responds that they are street performers and were only rehearsing. May starts to speak but Tsai cuts her off. Without another word, Tsai and May break into a run. Bo calls after them, demanding to know where the thief has gone. He looks around and realizes he has entered Governor Yu's compound.
related_events: Bo follows Tsai and May as they walk away quickly
Tsai claims they are street performers rehearsing
May tries to respond but is interrupted by Tsai
Tsai and May flee from Bo

name: Bo Finds Himself in Governor Yu's Compound
description: Bo loses sight of Tsai and May as they run ahead. He scans the area, searching for the thief, and suddenly realizes where he is. He stands within the walls of Governor Yu's compound, the grounds quiet and imposing around him.
related_events: Bo searches for the thief and realizes his location
Bo recognizes he is inside Governor Yu's compound

name: Te and May Identify Tsai's Body
description: Te and his men remove a cloth covering the body of Tsai. May stands beside them with Bo and confirms that the man is her father, a police inspector from Shaan. Te announces that the death must be reported to Governor Yu, noting that the victim was an officer. He then calls for Li and Yu to follow him as he leaves the room.
related_events: Te and his men uncover Tsai's body
May identifies the body as her father

name: Te Investigates Tsai's Murder and Seeks Governor Yu
description: Te and his men look down at the body of Tsai as a cloth is pulled away. Bo and May stand before them. May confirms that the dead man is her father, a police inspector from Shaan. Te states that the murder must be reported to Governor Yu, emphasizing that the victim was an officer. He expresses certainty that the killer is hiding in Tsai's compound. Te then calls for Li and Yu to follow him and leaves the room.
related_events: Te suspects the killer is hiding in Tsai's compound
Te decides to report the murder to Governor Yu

name: Governor Yu Backs Te's Lead, Pursuit Begins
description: Governor Yu stood by Te’s side, affirming his belief that the killer was hiding in the compound. Without hesitation, Te turned to Li and Yu, instructing them to come with him. The three men left the room together, moving out to follow the lead.
related_events: Governor Yu expresses strong confidence in Te's suspicion
Te orders Li and Yu to accompany him

name: De Lu and Yu Find a Woman in Sir Te's Study
description: De Lu and Yu approached Sir Te's study. De Lu opened the door and saw a young woman inside, studying the calligraphy scrolls on the walls. Startled, he asked her who she was. The woman turned and replied that she was Governor Yu's daughter and their guest for the day. De Lu told her this was Sir Te's private study and questioned why she was there. She said she had been looking for a quiet corner. De Lu introduced himself as Sir Te's head servant and gestured to the other guest standing beside him.
related_events: De Lu and Yu approach Sir Te's study
De Lu opens the study door and discovers a young woman inside
De Lu questions Jen's presence in Sir Te's study

name: De Lu and Jen Exchange Identities in the Study
description: De Lu opened the door to the study and found a young woman examining the calligraphy on the walls. Startled, he asked who she was. The woman replied that she was their guest that day and introduced herself as Governor Yu's daughter. De Lu stated that this was Sir Te's study and questioned her purpose there. She explained she had been looking for a quiet corner. De Lu then declared he was Sir Te's head servant and presented Yu as another guest.
related_events: De Lu identifies himself as Sir Te's head servant
De Lu introduces Yu as another guest
Jen introduces herself as Governor Yu's daughter and a guest

name: Jen Explains Her Presence in the Study
description: Jen stands among the calligraphy scrolls in Sir Te's study. De Lu opens the door and sees her, startled. He asks who she is. Jen replies that she is Governor Yu's daughter and says she was looking for a quiet corner. De Lu tells her this is Sir Te's study. He then introduces Yu and himself as guests of Sir Te.
related_events: Jen explains she was seeking a quiet corner

name: Madam Yu Returns and Sees the Posters
description: Madam Yu arrives from the temple and the governess helps her out of the carriage. Across the street, servants are peeling posters off a wall. Madam Yu notices the activity and asks what is happening. The maid tells her that someone has put up flyers. One torn poster on the ground reads, 'Jade Fox will not escape justice!' The governess scoffs, saying it is absurd to be searching for Jade Fox here. Madam Yu nods and walks inside. The governess tosses the flyer aside and follows. A hand reaches down, picks up the flyer, and pockets it—it is Yu.
related_events: Governess helps Madam Yu exit the carriage
Servants remove posters from a public wall
Madam Yu inquires about the张贴 posters
Maid informs Madam Yu about posters targeting Jade Fox

name: Madam Yu and the Jade Fox Flyer
description: Madam Yu steps out of the carriage as the governess helps her down. On the ground lies a partially torn flyer with the words 'Jade Fox will not escape justice!' Madam Yu bends slightly to look at it. The governess picks it up, muttering that it's preposterous to be searching for Jade Fox here. After Madam Yu has seen it, the governess tosses the flyer aside. Madam Yu walks toward the house, and the governess follows.
related_events: Madam Yu examines a torn flyer on the ground
Governess expresses disbelief at the search for Jade Fox
Governess discards the flyer after Madam Yu views it

name: Yu Picks Up the Torn Flyer
description: After the governess tossed the flyer aside, Yu bent down and picked it up from the ground. She looked it over quietly, then slipped it into her pocket and walked away.
related_events: Yu retrieves the discarded flyer from the ground
Yu examines the flyer and conceals it in her pocket

name: Li Mu Bai Confronts the Hooded Figure Under Moonlight
description: A hooded figure leaps down into the moonlight. Li Mu Bai steps forward from the shadows. He demands the sword from the figure.
related_events: Hooded figure jumps down in moonlight
Li Mu Bai reveals himself from hiding
Li Mu Bai demands the sword from the figure

name: Li Mu Bai Intercepts the Masked Figure
description: The masked figure lunged away, moving swiftly in the moonlight. Li Mu Bai sprang forward with incredible speed, closing the distance in an instant. He reached out and seized the sword from her grasp. As she tried to pull back, he held firm and demanded, 'Where's your master?' The figure only replied, 'What's it to you?' before breaking free and floating away into the darkness. Li Mu Bai immediately gave chase.
related_events: Masked figure attempts to escape
Li Mu Bai seizes the sword from the figure
Li Mu Bai questions the figure about her master

name: Li Mu Bai Chases the Floating Figure
description: After the masked figure floated away into the night, Li Mu Bai immediately gave chase, following her through the darkness as she moved swiftly across the landscape.
related_events: Masked figure escapes by floating away
Li Mu Bai chases the escaping figure

name: Thief Steals Sword from Room
description: A masked figure silently opens the window and enters the room. Moving quickly, the figure approaches the sword case, opens it, takes the sword, and wraps it up.
related_events: Masked figure breaks into room through window
Thief opens sword case and takes sword

name: Bo Confronts Thief and Raises the Alarm
description: Bo enters the room and sees a masked figure wrapping a sword from an open case. He moves to stop the thief, who leaps to the ceiling, steps over Bo, and jumps into the courtyard. Bo gives chase, but the thief outmaneuvers him and bounds onto the roof. Bo shouts for help, yelling that the sword has been stolen and pointing to the thief fleeing across the rooftops. The thief skips a few times and leaps into a side street. Bo grabs a pole and runs after him as gongs sound. People pour into the streets, including Yu Shu Lien.
related_events: Bo confronts thief and fails to stop escape
Bo raises alarm after theft

name: Thief Flees Across Roof and Escapes into Side Street
description: After leaping onto the roof, the thief runs swiftly across the tiles, skips a few steps, and jumps down into a narrow side street, disappearing from sight.
related_events: Thief escapes across roof and jumps to side street

name: The Alarm Spreads Through the Village
description: The gongs began to ring sharply, cutting through the night air. Bo's shouts echoed as he ran, pole in hand, yelling for help. Doors flung open and people poured into the streets, looking up toward the rooftops. Among them was Yu Shu Lien, stepping quickly into the courtyard, scanning the scene as neighbors gathered, alert and uneasy, searching for the thief.
related_events: Gongs sound to alert community of theft
Residents rush outside in response to alarm

name: The Figure Attacks Li in the Garden
description: The figure leaps into the garden and launches an attack on Li. Li dodges her strikes with quick, agile movements. Frustrated, the figure presses her assault, swinging wildly and losing control. Li grabs a branch and uses it to deflect her attacks, pushing her back.
related_events: Figure attacks Li in the garden
Li evades figure's attacks using agility
Figure intensifies attack and loses composure
Li uses branch to repel figure

name: Li Lifts the Mask and Offers Training
description: After evading the figure's wild attacks, Li uses a branch to deflect her strikes and gains the upper hand. He presses the stick gently against her mask, lifting it slightly. Standing in the quiet of the monastery garden, he tells her he believes she is good at her core, that even Jade Fox could not corrupt her. He offers to teach her the secrets of Wudan, to train her in the way of the Green Destiny, and says he is willing to risk his life to do so. The figure's eyes fill with tears. She spins away, shouting that Wudan is a whorehouse, and leaps into the darkness, leaving Li alone.
related_events: Li holds stick to figure's mask and gently lifts it
Li affirms belief in figure's inherent goodness despite corruption
Li expresses willingness to risk death to teach worthy disciple

name: The Figure Rejects Li's Teaching and Flees
description: The figure stands before Li in the monastery garden, her breath heavy from the exchange. When Li offers to teach her the Wudan secrets, she recoils, shouting that Wudan is a whorehouse. Without another word, she turns sharply, her cloak swirling as she runs from the courtyard. Li remains behind, motionless, watching her disappear into the night.
related_events: Figure rejects Li's offer to teach Wudan secrets
Figure flees from the monastery after emotional confrontation

name: Yu Entrusts Li Mu Bai's Sword to Sir Te
description: Yu brings Li Mu Bai's personal sword to Sir Te and places it before him. Sir Te recognizes it at once and hesitates, saying it is a hero's weapon and too fine a gift for him to accept. Yu insists, explaining that the sword has brought Li as much trouble as glory, and that Sir Te's help is needed for Li to leave his past behind and begin a new life. Moved by Yu's words, Sir Te agrees to take custody of the sword. At that moment, De Lu enters and announces the arrival of Governor Yu, prompting Sir Te to excuse himself to change. Yu thanks Sir Te for his kindness to both Li Mu Bai and herself, and Sir Te responds warmly, inviting her to stay the night as his guest.
related_events: Yu presents Li's personal sword to Sir Te
Sir Te agrees to act as custodian of the sword

name: Governor Yu Arrives
description: De Lu enters and announces that Governor Yu has arrived. Sir Te rises, saying he must change to receive the guest. Yu stands as well, expressing gratitude for Sir Te's kindness toward Li Mu Bai and himself. Sir Te assures him he is always welcome. Before leaving, Sir Te turns to Yu and asks about Li Mu Bai's decision to give up his sword, suggesting it might be a message meant for her. Yu responds that she does not know. Sir Te insists he has long been aware of the feelings between her and Li Mu Bai, and urges her to speak honestly with him. Yu objects that they are not cowards. Sir Te replies that even great heroes can be foolish when it comes to love, and promises to speak to Li Mu Bai himself. At that moment, De Lu's announcement cuts off their conversation.
related_events: De Lu announces Governor Yu's arrival

name: Yu Thanks Sir Te and Is Offered Hospitality
description: Yu rose and expressed his gratitude to Sir Te for the kindness he and Li Mu Bai had always received. Sir Te waved off the formality, urging Yu not to be a stranger, and invited him to stay the night as his guest.
related_events: Yu expresses gratitude to Sir Te
Sir Te invites Yu to stay the night as a guest

name: Sir Te Questions Shu Lien About Her Heart
description: Sir Te turned to Shu Lien and asked her directly about her feelings for Li Mu Bai. He suggested that Li Mu Bai giving up his sword and retiring from the life of a warrior might mean he was trying to tell her something. Sir Te said it was a shame that, after all these years, neither of them had spoken their hearts. He told her that even great heroes could be foolish when it came to love. Shu Lien responded that she and Li Mu Bai were not cowards. Sir Te insisted that if Li Mu Bai showed any sign of being more open the next time they met, he would not hesitate to speak to him firmly about it.
related_events: Sir Te inquires about Shu Lien's feelings for Li Mu Bai
Sir Te expresses regret over Shu Lien and Li Mu Bai's unspoken feelings
Shu Lien denies that she and Li Mu Bai are cowards
Sir Te offers to confront Li Mu Bai about his emotions

name: Sir Te Presents the Ceremonial Sword to Governor Yu
description: Sir Te handed the ceremonial sword to Governor Yu. Governor Yu took the sword and closed his eyes, feeling its balance and weight in his hands.
related_events: Sir Te hands the ceremonial sword to Governor Yu
Governor Yu closes his eyes to estimate the sword's weight

name: Sir Te Reveals the Glowing Sword
description: Sir Te snuffed out the candle flame, plunging the room into darkness. In one smooth motion, he drew the sword from its sheath. The blade emitted a soft, luminous blue glow, illuminating the space around him. The light revealed intricate engravings along the steel and highlighted the seven missing rubies set into the hilt.
related_events: Sir Te extinguishes the candle flame and draws the sword from its sheath

name: Sir Te Reveals the Sword's Measurements and History
description: Sir Te hands the sword to Governor Yu, who admires its elegance and closes his eyes to estimate its weight. Te extinguishes a candle flame and draws the sword from its sheath, revealing a luminous blue glow in the darkened room. He recites the blade's dimensions: two feet nine inches long, one inch wide, with a handle one inch deep, 0.6 inches wide, and seven-tenths of an inch thick. He notes seven rubies missing from the hilt and points out the engraving, a technique no longer used after the Han Dynasty, indicating the sword's origin before the Chin era.
related_events: Sir Te recites the precise dimensions and historical details of the sword

name: Governor Yu Praises Sir Te's Knowledge of the Sword
description: Governor Yu looks at the sword with admiration and tells Sir Te that his knowledge is remarkable. Sir Te responds by sliding the sword from its sheath in the darkened room, revealing a luminous blue glow. He recites the sword’s precise dimensions and notes the seven missing rubies on the hilt, pointing out the ancient engraving technique that predates the Han Dynasty. Governor Yu listens in silence. Sir Te then says that a sword by itself rules nothing, and that it only comes alive through skillful manipulation. Governor Yu acknowledges the point and invites him to continue.
related_events: Governor Yu praises Sir Te's extensive knowledge of the sword

name: Sir Te Advises Governor Yu on Ruling with Strength and Caution
description: Sir Te hands the sword to Governor Yu, who admires its craftsmanship and closes his eyes to estimate its weight. Te extinguishes a candle and draws the sword from its sheath, revealing a luminous blue glow in the dark. He recites the sword’s precise dimensions and notes the seven missing rubies on the hilt, identifying the engraving technique as one lost since the Han Dynasty. Governor Yu expresses admiration for Te’s knowledge. Te responds that a sword by itself rules nothing—it requires skillful handling to come alive. He then speaks of Peking’s unique challenges, warning that while the Imperial Court maintains tight security, the city is filled with unpredictable characters. He advises Governor Yu to proceed cautiously in enforcing law and order, to seek contacts in the Giang Hu underworld, and to remain both strong and supple in governance.

name: Yu Shows Li Mu Bai the Flyer Accusing Jade Fox
description: Yu and Li Mu Bai sit together in quiet conversation. Yu reaches into her sleeve and pulls out a flyer, which she hands to Li Mu Bai. He takes it, his expression shifting as he reads. 'Jade Fox? Impossible,' he says. Yu reminds him that they had always suspected she fled west. Li Mu Bai stares at the paper, stunned. 'I didn’t think she’d dare come back to Peking,' he mutters. Yu suggests there may be no safer place than under the nose of Governor Yu. Li Mu Bai clenches the flyer. 'So I shall avenge my master’s death after all.' Yu warns him to be careful—Sir Te demands discretion, and official matters are already difficult. She adds that even the flyer itself might be a trap. Li Mu Bai asks if she saw who posted it. Yu hesitates, then says no. He points out the flyer claims Jade Fox is hiding at Yu’s residence. On the night of the theft, there was a brawl near the Yu household. Was she involved? Yu says it was Bo, Sir Te’s man, who followed the thief to the Yus’. Li Mu Bai asks if she’s questioned Bo. She hasn’t. He presses further—were her men watching the compound? She admits she had already sent them home. She offers to take blame for losing the sword but asks for trust that she’ll recover it using her own methods. Li Mu Bai says that’s not what he meant. He doesn’t care about the sword. Yu is surprised. Didn’t he return for it? He says he didn’t know it was stolen until he arrived. Yu asks why he came back. Before he can answer, De Lu enters and interrupts. 'Pardon my intrusion. Master Li, your room is ready.' Li Mu Bai thanks him and follows him out.

name: Li's Return and the Weight of the Sword

During deep meditation, he entered a state of silence and light where time and space seemed to vanish. Instead of enlightenment, he was overcome by an endless sorrow he could not bear, forcing him to break off his practice. He admits something is pulling him back, something he cannot let go of. He then unwraps the bundle, revealing the ancient and beautiful Green Destiny Sword, and asks Yu to deliver it to Sir Te. Yu expresses surprise, questioning how Li can part with a weapon so tied to his identity. Li responds that too many have died by its blade and says it is time to leave it behind. He states his intention to visit his master's grave to pray for forgiveness, as he has not yet avenged his death at the hands of Jade Fox, though he is considering giving up the path of vengeance. Yu invites him to join her in Peking after, but Li does not answer.

Jen then asks if Yu is also a sword fighter. He draws the sword suddenly, producing an eerie sound, and confirms he is, though he prefers the machete. He returns the sword to its sheath. Jen expresses longing for the freedom of a fighter’s life. Yu replies that fighters live by rules—friendship, trust, integrity—and without them, they wouldn’t survive. Jen says she has read stories of martial artists roaming freely and fighting anyone in their way. Yu scoffs, saying those stories leave out the lack of baths and flea-ridden beds. Jen insists she knows what he means, and admits she is soon to be married but feels she hasn’t lived the life she wanted. Yu offers his congratulations and remarks that marriage is the most important step in a woman’s life. Jen asks if he is married. Yu looks at her and answers with a question, leaving his status unclear. The two stand in silence.
